name: Ruul Snowhoof
summary: Deep in northern Ashenvale, Ruul Snowhoof waits for rescue. The tauren druid is trapped in bear form inside a crude cage at Thistlefur Hold, relying on Horde adventurers to free him and guide him to safety.

sections.title: A Bear in a Cage
sections.body: Ruul Snowhoof entered northern Ashenvale and fell into the hands of the corrupt Thistlefur furbolgs. He took the shape of a bear, and his captors mistook him for a wild beast. They locked him in a wooden cage deep within Thistlefur Hold instead of killing him. Now weakened and unable to safely leave his form or fight his way out alone, Ruul waits for Horde allies to open the cage, drive off his captors, and clear a path through the den. He hopes to return to his sister, Yama Snowhoof, at Splintertree Post.

faq.q: Why is Ruul Snowhoof a bear in a cage?
faq.answer: Ruul Snowhoof took Bear Form when the Thistlefur furbolgs confronted him. They mistook the tauren druid for a wild beast and locked him in a cage deep inside their hold.

faq.q: Why don't the furbolgs just kill Ruul?
aliases: what do furbolgs want with ruul
faq.answer: The Thistlefur furbolgs keep Ruul captive in bear form and let him slowly starve in his cage. The reason they chose this over killing him is not known.

faq.q: Where does Ruul go after escaping Thistlefur Hold?
faq.answer: After Ruul escapes Thistlefur Hold, he asks his rescuers to tell his sister, Yama Snowhoof, that he survived. She is at Splintertree Post.

faq.q: Can Alliance players interact with Ruul Snowhoof?
faq.answer: No. Ruul Snowhoof is loyal to the Horde and offers help escaping only to Horde adventurers who find his cage.

angles.text: As a druid, finding Ruul caged in bear form shows the taint spreading through Ashenvale's wildlife and furbolg tribes.
As a tauren, rescuing Ruul Snowhoof brings a member of the Snowhoof family back alive to his sister Yama at Splintertree Post.
